name: Ansar Elements – News, Blog & Magazine Theme Builder for Elementor
author: themeansar

sections.description:
Ansar Elements is a lightweight Elementor addon that provides theme building features for news, blog, and magazine websites. It includes query loop widgets, post grid layouts, and template builders for headers, footers, archives, and single posts.

The plugin is designed to be beginner-friendly while still offering flexible controls for advanced users. It follows WordPress coding standards and is optimized for performance.

Post Query Loop & Dynamic Content

Create advanced blog and news layouts using the built-in Query Loop widgets.

  • Filter posts by category, tag, author, or custom taxonomy
  • Order posts by date, popularity, or custom fields
  • Build post grids, lists, and custom layouts
  • Ideal for dynamic magazine-style layouts, news portals, and blog websites

Features & Performance

Ansar Elements offers essential theme building features with clean, efficient code. Scripts and styles load only when needed, ensuring fast performance.

  • Header Builder – Design custom headers for your news or blog site
  • Footer Builder – Create dynamic footers with full customization
  • Archive Builder – Build category, tag, and author archive pages
  • Single Post Builder – Create fully customizable blog post and article templates
  • 404 Page Builder – Create custom error pages for your site
  • Post Grid & List Layouts – Display posts in responsive grid, list, or magazine-style layouts using Query Loop widgets
  • Responsive Design – Fully mobile-friendly and tablet-ready layouts
  • Elementor Compatibility – Works with the free version of Elementor
  • Compatible with Most WordPress Themes

Theme Builder Widgets

The following widgets are included:

  • [Site Logo] – Display your logo with custom sizing and linking
  • [Site Title] – Show your site name with styling controls
  • [Navigation Menu] – Horizontal, vertical, or expandable menu styles
  • [Search Widget] – Search with multiple layout options
  • [Copyright] – Dynamic copyright text with year auto-update

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the Ansar Elements plugin.
  2. Make sure the Elementor plugin is installed and activated.
  3. Go to Pages → Add New (or edit an existing page).
  4. Click on “Edit with Elementor”.
  5. Find the “Ansar Elements” widgets in the Elementor panel.
  6. Drag a widget into your layout and customize it using the available settings.

Why Choose Ansar Elements

Ansar Elements focuses specifically on news, magazine, and blog websites, providing essential theme building tools without unnecessary complexity.

Suitable For

  • News websites
  • Online magazines
  • Bloggers
  • Content publishers
  • Editorial websites
  • Personal blog creators
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor free version?

Yes. Ansar Elements works with the free version of Elementor.

Do you provide support?

Yes. Support is provided through the WordPress.org support forums for free users.

Will it work with my theme?

Ansar Elements works with most modern themes that support Elementor.
